title.narrative: NWFP Support to Strengthening of Procurement Regulatory Framework

description.narrative: NWFP is the leading province in terms of procurement reforms. Under the NWFP Procurement of Goods, Works, Services and Consulting Services Ordinance 2002, rules for procurement of consulting services were notified in November 2002, and rules for procurement of goods, works and (non-consultancy) services were notified in December 2003. The rules were designed and adopted by the officials of the Finance Department, without significant external assistance. Inevitably, therefore, these rules contain all the aspects of the existing procurement procedures without bringing in any changes to align the procedures with the modern public procurement practices. In line with the SACs and now the DPC (the SAC III has been replaced by DPC 1) supported PRP, this grant is needed to i. suggest few amendments in the ordinance, and bring the procurement rules closer to international best practice; ii. update the system of Composite Schedule of Rates (CSR) by Current Market Rates (CMR); iii. review the various codes, departmental rules and regulations to synchronize their application in context of the stipulations of the procurement ordinance as well as the new procurement rules. This will also include review and amendment in the existing standard Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) bidding and contract documents to make them more relevant to the needs of NWFP; iv. introduce sustainable procurement training for government officials; v. implement an effective mechanism to redress complaints with respect to procurement; vi. identify a home for procurement reforms for further research, database management and revisions; and vii. improve transparency and awareness of the reformed system. The request was cleared by Abid and has been approved by RIC.
